text:
Asha Patel: Quick sync — need to decide what gets yanked from MVP to hit Apr 10 internal launch.
Darin Cole: What's the target date? Are we still landing on Apr 10? :calendar:
Asha Patel: Yes, Apr 10. Current scope has three risky items: tenant SSO, live-embeddings cache, admin multi-tenant billing.
Rita Gomez: Customer asks pushing tenant SSO strongly — Acme payroll says it's a must, will they accept v1 only?
Simon Lee: From infra, embeddings cache adds ~2 sprints backend + routing changes. We can defer cache to v1 if team accepts ~10-15% higher token spend for 4–6 weeks.
Asha Patel: Proposal: MVP-core = generation + basic embeddings + manual billing flows. Defer tenant SSO and cache to v1 unless a customer condition forces scope-in.
Darin Cole: Agree in principle. What are gating metrics to re-include deferred items into MVP?
Asha Patel: Gates: 1) Gen P95 latency < 350ms on 90% traffic after quantization. 2) Two pilot customers sign off on manual billing flow (functionality + acceptance).
Rita Gomez: Problem: Acme says manual billing is a non-starter, they will only pilot with SSO present. :grimacing:
Simon Lee: We can offer a scoped SSO shim for Acme: no admin ui, just SAML assertion + IP allowlist. That cuts scope but still satisfies them. Proposed rollout config:
```
rollout:
  canary: 10%
  fallback: quant-model-128
  feature_flag: sso_scoped_alpha
```
Asha Patel: Contingency: If Acme requires SSO, ship a minimal SSO integration as part of MVP-alpha (no admin console, limited orgs). Owner = Rita + Simon.
Darin Cole: Who will own the acceptance criteria and timeline?
Asha Patel: Owners: Rita Gomez (customer negotiation + acceptance), Simon Lee (implementation). ETA for scoped SSO = 3 weeks. If not ready 2 weeks before launch -> revert to Plan B (no Acme pilot).
Rita Gomez: I'll log the risk in the roadmap doc and start negotiating with Acme product today.
ProductBot: milestone_update: MVP-target_date=2026-04-10, owners=["Rita Gomez","Simon Lee"], contingency=SSO-scoped-alpha
QA - Nate: Heads up — QA impact: full SSO adds ~3 QA sprints. Scoped alpha likely +1 sprint. Please factor into go/no-go.
Asha Patel: Action items: 1) Update roadmap doc with MVP-core, MVP-alpha, v1 backlog labels. 2) Rita + Simon to sync tomorrow 10:00am and confirm ETA. 3) Darin to find 1 eng resource to help with cache deferral plan. I'll run final triage EOD Thursday.
Darin Cole: I'll ping eng-rt for a volunteer to help Simon on cache deferral.
Rita Gomez: Confirmed — I'll take negotiation with Acme and share notes in the ticket. Sync tomorrow 10am.
Asha Patel: Thanks team. :pray:
